question: If the radius of a sphere is 35 cm, then its surface area is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The surface area of a sphere can be calculated directly by substituting the radius into the standard area formula.

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (35)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 1225 = 4900π

**∴ The correct answer is 4900π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 35 cm

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a Sphere = 4 × π × r²

 
 
• r = 35 cm Sphere Surface Area = 4πr² 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (35)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × (35 × 35)

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × π × 1225

⇒ Surface Area = 4900π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4900π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The total space enclosed by a sphere is given by V = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Surface Area

For a solid hemisphere, the Curved Surface Area (CSA) is half the sphere's surface (2 × π × r²), while the Total Surface Area (TSA) includes the flat circular base (3 × π × r²).

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere, given by V = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³.
